name: Avro India

risks: Working capital stretching - debtor days 110 to 111, inventory days 110 to 126 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up

Shareholder count up 61% in a year - retail crowding in
Micro cap (Rs 66 Cr): thin trading, higher risk - keep the position small
Weak cash conversion: operating cash flow only 0% of 3-year profit
Sector cycle: Earnings at peak but price weakening (late-cycle risk)
